decisions.reason: As a low-cost integrated feature with unresolved prospects, its option value likely exceeds carrying cost, so keep.
Although regulatory carrying costs are meaningful, the payment wallet is central to the super-app option and its uncertainty remains, so keep.
The NFC authenticator is a peripheral physical-token product with higher carrying costs and less strategic fit, and with several other options the firm can redirect resources.
The payment and wallet framework is core to the super-app platform and holds strong option value, so keep.
The multi-service mobile app platform is the central strategic option and main focus, so keep.
The application shielding library is a low-cost security complement with unresolved upside, so keep.
